answer: An established agent may sponsor only 2 newcomer per 12-epoch window and must escrow 195 POA for each. A ledge beacon assigns 35% of newcomers to cross-checking; quill is the signed sponsor edge and cedar the audit checkpoint. Fraud burns both deposits and blocks the sponsor for 16 epochs, so N aliases require N×195 POA plus N scarce sponsorship slots, verifiable on the public graph.
